decisions.reason: After several years without visible evidence of uptake, this adjacent conferencing offer would likely be judged below aspiration in a crowded market, so resources would be redirected.
Its early adoption signal and strong fit with the firm's core network and data-centre capabilities make continued retention more likely than withdrawal.

Optical spectrum connectivity remains closely aligned with owned fibre assets and the strategic move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure, so management would usually keep it unless results clearly deteriorate.
As a narrow portal-type offer with no recent visibility, it is likely either underperforming or better folded into broader automation tools, making withdrawal probable.
Although adjacent to the established voice business, weakening demand expectations for voice and the lack of recent market evidence suggest performance below aspiration and favor reallocation.
